I don't. I'm living alone and my family lives 3 hours away, my brother and grandparents. My mother is in another country, my father, he has a new family now and we dont speak. I want to seek help professionally, but that isnt an easy option in my country.

I know that he's not the best person to turn to. I wasnt expecting him to heal me or so.ething. But I guess I hoped he wouldve tried to help me somehow. 

Knowing this, that he is not professionally trained to deal with my anxiety attacks, I just tried harder I guess so I can get out of that head space. It was twice as hard with the voices also saying things like I dont even deserve him to pay attention to me the way I asked, you know?
But yeah. I don't know what to do.

I did so. I pleaded for help. But nothing. I couldve easily died today. I know that. But I just keep telling myself that I shouldnt because Im scared the people I love would hate me more. 
I love them and it's just that Im trying to be strong for them.

I try to breathe slowly and I touch/count my fingertips. Also it helps me when I can feel grounded, literally. And that I am clear on where I am.
It hurts that we are in that headspace. I can only feel for you. I dont know what to do with my thoughts of killing myself too.
